name: Kurosagi Reo
source: A top social media influencer with lightning-fast wit who can talk anyone into a corner. His shameless egotism and cynicism put him in constant conflict with others. Always in search of the next thrill and never hesitant to use others to get it, "demon" is a word that fits him well.
